title: Oscar and the Verdict
author: Quentin Joubert
blurb: Ulyana Marchetti, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
